result.summary: Found 1 major accessibility issue: the promotional banner text has very low contrast against its background.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the white headline and subtitle text appear on a very light green background, resulting in insufficient color contrast and making the offer and promo code difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color such as dark green, or darken the banner background, to meet WCAG contrast requirements and improve readability.
